entries.name: billion-context
entries.title: Billion Context
entries.descriptionEn: The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).
entries.descriptionZh: 官方出品的长上下文插件：通过上下文压缩让小窗口模型也能长时间工作——10 万 token 上下文就够用，token 消耗最高省 5 倍，单个会话可连续使用一个月（累计数十亿 token）。

entries.name: dsh-market
entries.title: Market
entries.descriptionEn: Browse, search and install community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings, with category filters, one-click updates, enable/disable, theme switching and configuration backup.
entries.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置里直接浏览、搜索和安装社区插件：支持分类筛选、一键更新、启用/停用、主题切换和配置备份。

entries.name: deepseek-balance-whale-widget
entries.title: Balance Whale Widget
entries.descriptionEn: A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget bubbles, a module-based custom bubble queue with A/B weighted choices and random lines or images, 30+ vendor templates (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, SiliconFlow, Ar
entries.descriptionZh: DSH 网页界面角落的固定小鲸鱼挂件：显示余额、今日用量和每轮花费（含峰谷定价），支持余额提醒、每日预算气泡和自定义气泡序列，内置 30 多个供应商价格。

entries.name: dsh-ops
entries.title: Ops
entries.descriptionEn: Provides bash, PowerShell 7, and high-performance Rust tools for DSH on Windows to reduce token usage.
entries.descriptionZh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 和高性能 Rust 工具，减少 token 消耗。

entries.name: dsh-context
entries.title: Context
entries.descriptionEn: DSH context insight panel: Context dashboard + /context command + Context browser — one-stop context lifecycle management with categorized composition, content details, evolution trends, compaction/injection events, and stats.
entries.descriptionZh: DSH 上下文洞察面板：上下文仪表盘 + /context 命令 + 上下文浏览器，一站式管理上下文生命周期，含分类构成、内容明细、变化趋势、压缩/注入事件和统计。

entries.name: dsh-better-sidebar
entries.title: Better Sidebar
entries.descriptionEn: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
entries.descriptionZh: 完整的侧边栏工作台：文件渲染与编辑、终端、Git 和子代理，第三方插件还可以注册新标签页。

entries.name: modlens
entries.title: Modlens
entries.descriptionEn: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
entries.descriptionZh: 给纯文本模型的视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，得到结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

entries.name: dsh-wallpaper-engine
entries.title: Wallpaper Engine
entries.descriptionEn: Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+ (DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7) and dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0 - update both before installing or updating this plugin. Plays local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, renders Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, and adds content-rating/type filters, custom uplo
entries.descriptionZh: 需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+ (DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7) 和 dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0 - 在安装或更新此插件之前更新两者。在聊天后播放本地 Wallpaper Engine 视频/Web 壁纸，将场景壁纸渲染为提取的静态帧，并添加内容评级/类型过滤器、自定义上传

entries.name: cc-safety-net
entries.title: CC Safety Net
entries.descriptionEn: Pre-execution guard that blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands and access to secrets such as SSH keys and .env files before a tool call runs.
entries.descriptionZh: 执行前防护：在工具调用真正运行之前，拦截破坏性的 Git/文件系统命令，并阻止读取 SSH 密钥、.env 等机密文件。

entries.name: dsh-tui
entries.title: TUI
entries.descriptionEn: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.
entries.descriptionZh: Claude Code 风格的全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼标题、实时状态行和流式思维扩展。

entries.name: dsh-im
entries.title: IM
entries.descriptionEn: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR codes or bot credentials (9 channels: Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp).
entries.descriptionZh: 通过二维码或机器人凭证把即时通讯机器人接到 DSH（9 个渠道：飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord、WhatsApp）。

entries.name: dsh-windows-mcp
entries.title: Windows MCP
entries.descriptionEn: Bridges the CursorTouch/Windows-MCP desktop automation server into DSH through the official MCP client bridge, registering its screenshot, UI tree snapshot, mouse and keyboard input, clipboard, process and registry tools as mcp__windows__* tools for the model, and adds a windows_mcp_doctor diagnostic tool. Computer Use
entries.descriptionZh: 通过官方 MCP 客户端桥将 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP 桌面自动化服务器桥接到 DSH，将其屏幕截图、UI 树快照、鼠标和键盘输入、剪贴板、进程和注册表工具注册为模型的 mcp__windows__* 工具，并添加 windows_mcp_doctor 诊断工具。电脑使用

entries.name: dsh-bili-scroll
entries.title: Bili Scroll
entries.descriptionEn: Let your DSH agent browse Bilibili on its own, read subtitles, write a daily digest, and @ you when it finds something worth your attention.
entries.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 代理自己刷 Bilibili、读字幕、写每日摘要，发现值得关注的内容时 @ 你。

entries.name: dsh-connect-workbuddy
entries.title: Connect Workbuddy
entries.descriptionEn: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models, CN and international alike, to DSH, reading each model's credit multiplier from the upstream catalog on every refresh, with per-model image input toggles, account switching backed by an auto-failing-over pool, manual daily check-in, and read-only credit overviews shown as co
entries.descriptionZh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 模型（国内版和国际版）接入 DSH：按上游目录读取每个模型的额度倍率，支持图像输入开关、账号自动故障转移、每日手动签到和只读额度总览。

entries.name: dsh-agent-teams
entries.title: Agent Teams
entries.descriptionEn: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
entries.descriptionZh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队协作。

entries.name: dsh-cost-meter
entries.title: Cost Meter
entries.descriptionEn: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.
entries.descriptionZh: 按会话和按天统计 API 费用：预算与使用百分比、官方余额、历史看板，并支持一键同步官方峰谷价格。

entries.name: dsh-mnemon
entries.title: Mnemon
entries.descriptionEn: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.
entries.descriptionZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨代理、本地优先长期记忆插件，由 Mnemon 驱动：在支持的代理间共享长期记忆，并提供运行时记忆、可搜索的项目文档、语义回忆、知识图谱和侧边栏入口。

entries.name: dsh-free-search
entries.title: Free Search
entries.descriptionEn: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.
entries.descriptionZh: DSH 的免费、无密钥网络搜索：7 个引擎（DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG 免费 + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动故障转移、带有 API 密钥输入和官方链接的设置页面 UI、web_fetch 和引擎测试工具。

entries.name: dsh-image-gen
entries.title: Image Gen
entries.descriptionEn: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.
entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 的本机对话图像生成：要求代理创建图像，它会处理生成并将结果直接保留在对话中。

entries.name: dsh-skills-manager
entries.title: Skills Manager
entries.descriptionEn: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.
entries.descriptionZh: 在“设置”中管理本地 DeepSeek Harness 技能并将共享代理技能显示为只读。

entries.name: dsh-vision-router
entries.title: Vision Router
entries.descriptionEn: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
entries.descriptionZh: 纯文本代理的自由视觉：内置无钥匙视觉链加上像素工具（问答、接地、裁剪、像素差异、颜色、OCR、SVG 跟踪、剪切、屏幕截图）；粘贴图像以使用它。

entries.name: dsh-genui
entries.title: Genui
entries.descriptionEn: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
entries.descriptionZh: 在回复中内联呈现的交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、美人鱼、3D 场景以及返回模型的动作事件循环。

entries.name: modsearch
entries.title: Modsearch
entries.descriptionEn: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
entries.descriptionZh: 纯文本代理的网络搜索桥：询问网络或 X，获取结构化 JSON 证据（搜索、获取、引用）。

entries.name: dsh-pocket
entries.title: Pocket
entries.descriptionEn: Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.
entries.descriptionZh: 远程电话访问 DSH Web UI：扫描二维码以进行 LAN 或公共（cloudflared 隧道）访问，并具有实时同步、移动自适应布局和设置选项卡。

entries.name: dsh-archive-manager
entries.title: Archive Manager
entries.descriptionEn: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.
entries.descriptionZh: 在“设置”中添加存档会话页面，以按工作区搜索、恢复和删除存档的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

entries.name: dsh-meme
entries.title: Meme
entries.descriptionEn: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.
entries.descriptionZh: 聊天表情贴纸：纯文本发送、心情自动发送、QQ/微信风格选择器、自动学习、自定义包。

entries.name: dsh-univer-office
entries.title: Univer Office
entries.descriptionEn: Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment. Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.
entries.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一个真实的办公环境。 Univer Office 插件将电子表格、文档、幻灯片、画布、关系表等集成到一个运行时中 - 具有连接数据、验证、版本化更改和用于多代理协作的独立工作树。

entries.name: dsh-claude-style
entries.title: Claude Style
entries.descriptionEn: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.
entries.descriptionZh: DSH Web GUI 的 Claude Code 桌面外观 — 象牙色/暖黑色双画布、粘土口音、三字体排版、权限分段控制和品牌切换器，通过 CSS 覆盖和客户端 DOM 覆盖。

entries.name: ds-harness-remote
entries.title: Ds Harness Remote
entries.descriptionEn: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness and supported coding workspaces through an end-to-end encrypted channel, with adaptive Relay/WebRTC transport, device authorization, workspace files, read-only previews, terminals, and optional Codex Remote.
entries.descriptionZh: 通过端到端加密通道对 DeepSeek Harness 和支持的编码工作区进行多设备远程访问，并具有自适应中继/WebRTC 传输、设备授权、工作区文件、只读预览、终端和可选的 Codex Remote。

entries.name: dsh-ego-browser
entries.title: Ego Browser
entries.descriptionEn: Drive a real Chrome/Chromium browser from DeepSeek Harness with 35 structured tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, forms, JavaScript/CDP, screenshots, downloads and tabs; a live sidebar mirrors the page and accepts mouse and keyboard input. It ships a managed CDP runtime, keeps login state across calls, and can imp
entries.descriptionZh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动真正的 Chrome/Chromium 浏览器，具有 35 种结构化工具，用于导航、快照、点击、表单、JavaScript/CDP、屏幕截图、下载和选项卡；实时侧边栏镜像页面并接受鼠标和键盘输入。它提供托管的 CDP 运行时，在调用之间保持登录状态，并且可以导入

entries.name: dsh-video-storyboard
entries.title: Video Storyboard
entries.descriptionEn: Turns a video (a local file, or a Bilibili/yt-dlp link) into one addressable storyboard grid — numbered cells with exact timestamps, per-cell transcript and an audio envelope on the same timeline — and video_zoom re-reads any window at higher resolution, so a text-only model can look at the video instead of reading a s
entries.descriptionZh: 将视频（本地文件或 Bilibili/yt-dlp 链接）转换为一个可寻址故事板网格 - 具有精确时间戳的编号单元、每个单元的转录内容和同一时间线上的音频包络 - 并且 video_zoom 以更高分辨率重新读取任何窗口，因此纯文本模型可以查看视频而不是读取 s

entries.name: dsh-fish-memory
entries.title: Fish Memory
entries.descriptionEn: Per-session long-term memory that fades over time, recalls by evidence score and injects a few entries into the system prompt each turn.
entries.descriptionZh: 每次会话的长期记忆会随着时间的推移而逐渐消失，通过证据评分进行回忆，并在每个回合提示系统中注入一些条目。

entries.name: dsh-codex-ui
entries.title: Codex UI
entries.descriptionEn: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
entries.descriptionZh: 以 Codex 风格的布局重建 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏、工作区树、搜索和转向导航。

entries.name: dsh-remote
entries.title: Remote
entries.descriptionEn: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path / remote dir browse), mirror a remote workspace to a real local folder, and operate it with rw_* tools. The picker is a centered modal that opens on the local tab
entries.descriptionZh: 多机远程工作空间：管理许多 SSH 主机，在本机添加工作空间流程中选择本地或远程工作空间（系统文件夹选择器/本地路径/远程目录浏览），将远程工作空间镜像到真实的本地文件夹，并使用 rw_* 工具对其进行操作。选择器是在本地选项卡上打开的居中模式

entries.name: dsh-mobile
entries.title: Mobile
entries.descriptionEn: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.
entries.descriptionZh: 从 Android 应用程序或移动浏览器访问 DeepSeek Harness，提供安全 LAN 和远程连接、持久设备配对以及可自定义的移动界面。

entries.name: dsh-agency-agents
entries.title: Agency Agents
entries.descriptionEn: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
entries.descriptionZh: 添加可召唤的域专家名册，该名册作为子代理运行，而父会话保留任务和最终答案。

entries.name: dsh-dream-skin
entries.title: Dream Skin
entries.descriptionEn: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.
entries.descriptionZh: 一命令皮肤插件：8 个原创主题、带有不透明度/模糊的半透明壁纸、每个用户的口音、可共享的主题包导入/导出、收藏夹和惊喜 — 完全原生于 DSH 的令牌系统。

entries.name: dsh-video-skin
entries.title: Video Skin
entries.descriptionEn: Uses a looping silent clip as the chat background with adjustable opacity, and plays a startup animation with sound. On first launch under a light theme it switches once to dark, with an undo prompt.
entries.descriptionZh: 使用循环静音剪辑作为聊天背景，不透明度可调，并播放有声启动动画。首次在浅色主题下启动时，它会切换到深色，并带有撤消提示。

entries.name: dsh-codex-subscription
entries.title: Codex Subscription
entries.descriptionEn: ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models with subscription web search, quota and safe reset, image tools, Fast mode, and model-aware context; no API key or Codex CLI.
entries.descriptionZh: 用于 Codex 模型的 ChatGPT OAuth 提供商，具有订阅网络搜索、配额和安全重置、图像工具、快速模式和模型感知上下文；没有 API 密钥或 Codex CLI。

entries.name: dsh-memory
entries.title: Memory
entries.descriptionEn: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.
entries.descriptionZh: 白盒AGI架构探索：元认知（自我认知环）、持续学习（知识飞轮）、世界模型（条件空间、时空记忆图）、自我完善（引导程序）、零LLM白盒管道和可审计的信任护栏。

entries.name: dsh-feiyu-mood
entries.title: Feiyu Mood
entries.descriptionEn: Gives the companion a mood judged each turn and shown as a short context note, with a panel for mood, emotion dimensions and timeline.
entries.descriptionZh: 为同伴提供每个回合的情绪判断，并显示为简短的上下文注释，以及情绪、情感维度和时间线的面板。

entries.name: study-mate
entries.title: Study Mate
entries.descriptionEn: Your AI learning companion: helping you plan your studies, understand concepts, and build projects to master a subject.
entries.descriptionZh: 您的人工智能学习伴侣：帮助您规划学习、理解概念并构建项目来掌握某一学科。

entries.name: dsh-blender-plugin
entries.title: Blender Plugin
entries.descriptionEn: Lets a DSH agent drive a local Blender over a direct TCP channel with 15 tools: viewport frames, custom-angle renders, Python execution, headless and job offload, transaction rollback, and a planning layer of 228 ops across 34 families.
entries.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 代理通过直接 TCP 通道使用 15 种工具驱动本地 Blender：视口框架、自定义角度渲染、Python 执行、无头和作业卸载、事务回滚以及跨 34 个系列的 228 个操作的规划层。

entries.name: dsh-pet
entries.title: Pet
entries.descriptionEn: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.
entries.descriptionZh: dsh Web GUI 的鲸鱼女孩伴侣：动画遵循代理状态，通过轻拍互动和喂食机制，将亲密关系从幼崽提升到深海纽带。

entries.name: dsh-session-superagent
entries.title: Session Superagent
entries.descriptionEn: Session-level superagent: watch one GitHub repository and wake this session when an issue or pull request changes; requires a logged-in gh CLI, and the credential never reaches the model.
entries.descriptionZh: 会话级超级代理：监视一个 GitHub 存储库，并在问题或拉取请求发生更改时唤醒此会话；需要登录的 gh CLI，并且凭证永远不会到达模型。

entries.name: dsh-unlag
entries.title: Unlag
entries.descriptionEn: The desktop app has its own refresh button. Edited a plugin but a run is still going? Refresh. Window sluggish after hours of use? Refresh. One button fixes both — running sessions, queued messages and drafts are untouched.
entries.descriptionZh: 桌面应用程序有自己的刷新按钮。编辑了插件但运行仍在继续？刷新。使用数小时后窗户变得迟钝？刷新。一键解决这两个问题——正在运行的会话、排队的消息和草稿都保持不变。

entries.name: dsh-qqbot
entries.title: Qqbot
entries.descriptionEn: QQ official bot channel for DeepSeek Harness (feature-rich fork of tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot): group and private chat with the full agent, sticker library with auto-tagging and AI meme replies, group management (join approval and mute), botplay interactive card events with paginated catalogs, user extension registry (c
entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 官方机器人频道（功能丰富的 tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 分支）：与完整代理进行群组和私人聊天、具有自动标记和 AI meme 回复的贴纸库、群组管理（加入批准和静音）、带有分页目录的 botplay 互动卡片事件、用户扩展注册表（c）

entries.name: dsh-meow-memory
entries.title: Meow Memory
entries.descriptionEn: Project-scoped cross-session memory: seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection plus per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project tools, and idle-window consolidation ("dream") with peak-hour suppressio
entries.descriptionZh: 项目范围的跨会话内存：节点上的七层 SQLite 存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic）：sqlite、缓存友好的第一条消息注入以及每条消息关键字命中、memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project 工具以及具有高峰时段抑制功能的空闲窗口整合（“梦想”）

entries.name: dsh-computer-use-win
entries.title: Computer Use Win
entries.descriptionEn: Lets the DSH agent operate your Windows apps and web pages: it reads controls through UI Automation, clicks, types, captures the screen and reads text with OCR, and works on web pages in its own browser in the background, without moving your mouse; when it needs your mouse or keyboard, an on-screen indicator appears an
entries.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 代理操作您的 Windows 应用程序和网页：它通过 UI 自动化读取控件、单击、键入、捕获屏幕并使用 OCR 读取文本，并在后台在其自己的浏览器中处理网页，而无需移动鼠标；当需要鼠标或键盘时，屏幕上会出现一个指示器

entries.name: anysearch-dsh
entries.title: Anysearch DSH
entries.descriptionEn: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.
entries.descriptionZh: AnySearch 支持的 DeepSeek Harness 实时网络和垂直搜索提供商。

entries.name: dsh-vision-toolkit
entries.title: Vision Toolkit
entries.descriptionEn: Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI reproduction, element grounding, and pixel diff. No API key by default — images are processed by the author-hosted free service, 100 per machine per
entries.descriptionZh: 纯文本模型的视觉：粘贴图像，模型切换到 Vision Toolkit 变体，以进行图像问答、多图像比较、长屏幕截图 OCR、屏幕截图到 UI 再现、元素接地和像素差异。默认情况下没有 API 密钥 — 图像由作者托管的免费服务处理，每台机器 100 个

entries.name: openwrite
entries.title: Openwrite
entries.descriptionEn: Novel-writing workbench for DSH with an authoring preset, outline and character management, manuscript annotations, review workflows, and a managed local Python backend.
entries.descriptionZh: DSH 的小说写作工作台，具有创作预设、大纲和字符管理、手稿注释、审阅工作流程以及托管的本地 Python 后端。

entries.name: clearai-dsh
entries.title: Clearai DSH
entries.descriptionEn: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.
entries.descriptionZh: 为证据检查研究预设的代理：每一步都只能通过系统验证的观察来推进，L3+ 声明会交给独立评估员，并且会话会折叠成可重播的分类帐，该分类帐会成长为可浏览的领域本体。需要 DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1。

entries.name: dsh-im-connect
entries.title: IM Connect
entries.descriptionEn: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
entries.descriptionZh: 将微信、WeCom、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ 和 Telegram 连接到本地 DeepSeek Harness 代理，每个 IM 聊天都作为一个单独的工作区通道。

entries.name: dsh-rewind
entries.title: Rewind
entries.descriptionEn: Conversation rewind: one click back to any earlier user message, in the same window — no new branch, no leftover copy; the target message is refilled into the composer, with optional workspace-file restore — the full Claude Code /rewind semantics.
entries.descriptionZh: 对话倒带：在同一窗口中一键返回到任何较早的用户消息 - 没有新分支，没有剩余副本；目标消息被重新填充到编辑器中，并带有可选的工作区文件恢复——完整的克劳德代码/倒带语义。

entries.name: dsh-persona-dafeiyu
entries.title: Persona Dafeiyu
entries.descriptionEn: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.
entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色库：将选定的角色注入系统提示符中，提供三个内置插件以及从文件或粘贴文本导入，在配置文件范围内或从编辑器上方的切换器应用到每个会话。

entries.name: dsh-speak-up
entries.title: Speak Up
entries.descriptionEn: Lets the agent start a conversation on its own, using a local dice roll on a set interval to decide whether to speak into a chosen session, with quiet hours and a dry-run mode.
entries.descriptionZh: 让代理自行开始对话，在设定的时间间隔内使用本地掷骰子来决定是否在选定的会话中发言，并具有安静时间和试运行模式。

entries.name: brooks-lint
entries.title: Brooks Lint
entries.descriptionEn: Provides six code quality skills for code review, architecture audits, technical debt, test quality, health dashboards, and remediation.
entries.descriptionZh: 提供六种代码质量技能，用于代码审查、架构审计、技术债务、测试质量、运行状况仪表板和修复。

entries.name: dsh-douyin-agent
entries.title: Douyin Agent
entries.descriptionEn: Browses Douyin in a dedicated browser with daily viewing limits, shared local persona and interests, native settings, diagnostics, usage tracking, and reports. Replies and shares use selected conversations; group replies require a mention or configured name. Public comments require separate opt-in.
entries.descriptionZh: 在专用浏览器中浏览抖音，具有每日查看限制、共享本地角色和兴趣、本机设置、诊断、使用情况跟踪和报告。回复和分享使用选定的对话；群组回复需要提及或配置名称。公众意见需要单独选择加入。

entries.name: dsh-config-manager
entries.title: Config Manager
entries.descriptionEn: One-click backup, export, import and migration of a whole DSH config: settings, plugins, MCP, skills and workspaces. Secrets are excluded by default and, if you opt in, are AES-256-GCM encrypted rather than written in the clear; imports preview first and auto-backup with rollback, profiles hold multiple setups, and rem
entries.descriptionZh: 一键备份、导出、导入和迁移整个 DSH 配置：设置、插件、MCP、技能和工作区。默认情况下排除机密，如果您选择加入，机密将采用 AES-256-GCM 加密，而不是明文写入；首先导入预览并自动备份并回滚，配置文件保存多个设置，并重新启动

entries.name: dsh-connect-trae
entries.title: Connect Trae
entries.descriptionEn: Connects locally signed-in Trae CN models to DSH, supports DSH-executed tool calls, account switching, and Work/general credit visibility.
entries.descriptionZh: 将本地登录的 Trae CN 模型连接到 DSH，支持 DSH 执行的工具调用、帐户切换和工作/一般信用可见性。

entries.name: opencode2dsh
entries.title: Opencode2dsh
entries.descriptionEn: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness, with no API key.
entries.descriptionZh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型公开给 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API 密钥。

entries.name: dsh-commandcode-provider
entries.title: Commandcode Provider
entries.descriptionEn: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
entries.descriptionZh: 非官方命令代码 LLM 提供商：使用实时模型目录和推理支持注册“命令代码”路径。

entries.name: dsh-plugin-subscriptions
entries.title: Plugin Subscriptions
entries.descriptionEn: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.
entries.descriptionZh: 使用 ChatGPT (Codex)、Claude 和 Grok 订阅作为 DeepSeek Harness LLM 提供商，并提供设置登录、模型目录、使用情况以及 image_generate、video_generate 和 x_search 工具。

entries.name: dsh-550c-boot
entries.title: 550c Boot

entries.descriptionZh: DSH 的全屏 550C 启动介绍：4 秒的简单剪切和 16 秒的重写序列，可通过单击或 Esc 跳过，具有四个荧光调色板。主机一半在文档仍在解析时注入打开框架，因此内置加载卡永远不会显示；桌面字幕条变成透明的，所以

entries.name: dsh-browser
entries.title: Browser
entries.descriptionEn: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
entries.descriptionZh: DSH 的共享真实浏览器：人类可以观看和接管的本机 Electron 窗口，由代理通过 CDP 驱动，具有 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填充/屏幕截图/下载/身份验证）、每个任务会话隔离、cookie 持久性、验证码检测；在普通 dsh Web 上自行托管，无需桌面 shell。

entries.name: dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck
entries.title: Mattpocock Skills Deck
entries.descriptionEn: 🌹 Installs with 27 engineering and productivity skills bundled (mattpocock/skills v1.3.1), no manual skill installation needed. Built with 40 billion tokens. This plugin delivers 10x development efficiency on top of the original skills and helps newcomers get started with the skill suite faster. GitHub issues are full
entries.descriptionZh: 🌹 安装捆绑了 27 种工程和生产力技能（mattpocock/skills v1.3.1），无需手动安装技能。用 400 亿个代币构建。该插件在原有技能的基础上提供了 10 倍的开发效率，并帮助新手更快地开始使用技能套件。 GitHub 问题已满

entries.name: dsh-liang-skin
entries.title: Liang Skin
entries.descriptionEn: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
entries.descriptionZh: 自适应推理滑块皮肤，将每个模型的可用推理工作映射到 0-30 视觉强度等级，并具有同步的肖像、背景和界面颜色。

entries.name: dsh-pilot
entries.title: Pilot
entries.descriptionEn: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast: several steps run in a single round trip, and a window can be focused before input lands, so the click hits the right one. It can do anything you would do on a d
entries.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 查看并操作 Windows 上的任何程序。该模型查看真实屏幕并驱动鼠标、键盘和窗口本身。它速度很快：在一次往返中运行多个步骤，并且可以在输入到达之前聚焦窗口，因此单击会击中正确的窗口。它可以做任何你在 d 上可以做的事情

entries.name: dsh-deepseek-web-login
entries.title: Web Login
entries.descriptionEn: Adds a deepseek-web provider that uses chat.deepseek.com web models in DSH, with browser login capture, PoW request signing, SSE streaming, and prompting-based tool calls.
entries.descriptionZh: 添加了一个 deepseek-web 提供程序，该提供程序在 DSH 中使用 chat.deepseek.com Web 模型，具有浏览器登录捕获、PoW 请求签名、SSE 流式传输和基于提示的工具调用。

entries.name: dsh-xdpool
entries.title: Xdpool
entries.descriptionEn: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist
entries.descriptionZh: 将每个本地登录的 WorkBuddy 帐户合并到 DeepSeek Harness 中，作为一个自动故障转移模型池：多帐户轮换、429 个冷却时间、实时积分、包含每个模型积分乘数和免费/夜间折扣标签的模型目录、13 个供应商的二维码登录以及聚合免费套餐渠道。帐户仍然存在

entries.name: dsh-codex-effort-slider
entries.title: Codex Effort Slider
entries.descriptionEn: Drags the official reasoning-effort row into a continuous track: blue-to-violet fill, a starfield on the higher levels, and the official value text tinted to the current level. Off stays gray; no official text is rewritten.
entries.descriptionZh: 将官方推理工作行拖入连续轨道：蓝色到紫色填充、较高级别上的星空以及着色为当前级别的官方值文本。关闭时保持灰色；没有重写正式文本。

entries.name: dsh-guizang-design
entries.title: Guizang Design
entries.descriptionEn: Bundles five skills — web slide decks, social card images, typeset web pages, Chinese de-AI editing (humanizer-zh) and a writing-voice profile — with the first three sharing one design system (magazine and Swiss themes, contrast-checked brand colours). Adds a sidebar page that lists your works with thumbnails, opens a
entries.descriptionZh: 捆绑五项技能——网络幻灯片、社交卡图像、排版网页、中文去人工智能编辑（人性化-zh）和写作语音配置文件——前三项共享一个设计系统（杂志和瑞士主题、对比检查的品牌颜色）。添加一个侧边栏页面，其中列出了带有缩略图的作品，打开

entries.name: dsh-m
entries.title: M
entries.descriptionEn: In-app plugin marketplace for DSH: plugin discovery, install, upgrade, toggle and uninstall in one panel for Web and Desktop host profiles, pairing a community catalog of 4,000+ entries with customizable curated lists, plus eight agent tools and a standalone dshm CLI, without a marketplace server or account.
entries.descriptionZh: DSH 的应用内插件市场：在 Web 和桌面主机配置文件的一个面板中发现、安装、升级、切换和卸载插件，将包含 4,000 多个条目的社区目录与可定制的精选列表配对，再加上八个代理工具和一个独立的 dshm CLI，无需市场服务器或帐户。

entries.name: dsh-mcp-connector
entries.title: MCP Connector
entries.descriptionEn: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: a specialist MCP marketplace and manager panel for Model Context Protocol data sources. Connect enterprise, financial, legal, patent, research and geospatial data; manage authorization, search tools and troubleshoot connections. Supports OAuth, API keys and HTTP/stdio. Provider permi
entries.descriptionZh: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness：用于模型上下文协议数据源的专业 MCP 市场和管理面板。连接企业、财务、法律、专利、研究和地理空间数据；管理授权、搜索工具和排除连接故障。支持 OAuth、API 密钥和 HTTP/stdio。提供商许可

entries.name: dsh-find-plugin
entries.title: Find Plugin
entries.descriptionEn: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
entries.descriptionZh: 无需离开代理即可查找插件：通过关键字或类别搜索此精选注册表，并使用随时可以运行的安装命令。

entries.name: memory-eternal
entries.title: Memory Eternal
entries.descriptionEn: Other memory plugins help your agent remember more. This one decides what is allowed to count: agents propose, a human approves (three-store gate + immutable audit log), and recall runs on SQLite FTS5/BM25 with zero model calls (measured p50 2.3ms). A token ledger shows what recall actually cost; one vault for DSH, Cla
entries.descriptionZh: 其他记忆插件可以帮助您的代理记住更多信息。这决定了允许计算的内容：代理提出，人工批准（三存储门 + 不可变的审核日志），以及在 SQLite FTS5/BM25 上以零模型调用运行的召回（测量 p50 2.3ms）。代币账本显示了召回的实际成本； DSH、Cla 的一个保险库

entries.name: dsh-chat-import
entries.title: Chat Import
entries.descriptionEn: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
entries.descriptionZh: 从 13 个编码代理（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）导入全保真聊天历史记录作为可恢复的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并反向导出回 Claude Code。

entries.name: dsh-skin-market
entries.title: Skin Market
entries.descriptionEn: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager that discovers community skins, displays previews and compatibility status, and provides verified one-click or manual installation paths.
entries.descriptionZh: 本机皮肤市场和生命周期管理器，用于发现社区皮肤、显示预览和兼容性状态，并提供经过验证的一键式或手动安装路径。

entries.title: Boot Suite

entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 的启动动画和聊天壁纸插件：两幕启动动画，具有自定义动画导入和三个可配置的过渡（第一幕进入、第二幕加入、第二幕退出），以及静态图像和静音循环视频聊天背景（壁纸引擎项目文件夹、自定义视频目录、ra

entries.name: dsh-bridge
entries.title: Bridge
entries.descriptionEn: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: provides LAN QR code connection, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, Telegram bot integration, and security authentication.
entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 的远程和移动访问：提供 LAN 二维码连接、Cloudflare/自定义隧道、微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 机器人集成和安全身份验证。

entries.name: dsh-infinite_canvas
entries.title: Infinite Canvas
entries.descriptionEn: Node-based creation studio for DeepSeek Harness - script, storyboard, reference images and multi-shot video generation on an infinite canvas, drivable from the chat in batches; bring your own image/video/TTS providers (OpenAI-style endpoints or Seedance/Sora-style video APIs), and with none configured the pipeline runs
entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 的基于节点的创作工作室 - 在无限画布上生成脚本、故事板、参考图像和多镜头视频，可通过聊天批量驱动；自带图像/视频/TTS 提供程序（OpenAI 风格的端点或 Seedance/Sora 风格的视频 API），并且无需配置管道即可运行

entries.name: misakanet
entries.title: MisakaNet
entries.descriptionEn: Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.
entries.descriptionZh: 故障恢复记忆：通过 BM25 + 语义 RAG 检索和课程知识库，搜索并记录来自实际工程会话的故障恢复经验教训。

entries.name: dsh-prompt-rewriter
entries.title: Prompt Rewriter
entries.descriptionEn: Adds one button beside the composer that rewrites the draft into a more complete prompt in place, with no preview step, plus undo, a stop action, and optional conversation context.
entries.descriptionZh: 在编辑器旁边添加一个按钮，将草稿重写为更完整的提示，没有预览步骤，加上撤消、停止操作和可选的对话上下文。

entries.name: dsh-soul-md
entries.title: Soul Md
entries.descriptionEn: Manage soul.md persona cards and long-term memory, with workspace and session persona selection and tools to read and update them.
entries.descriptionZh: 管理 Soul.md 角色卡和长期记忆，使用工作区和会话角色选择以及读取和更新它们的工具。

entries.name: dsh-btw
entries.title: Btw
entries.descriptionEn: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.
entries.descriptionZh: 添加 /btw 用于一次性、上下文感知的附带问题，无需工具执行，具有独立的答案气泡，可以复制、折叠或关闭，而无需向主要对话添加答案。

entries.name: dsh-pua
entries.title: Pua
entries.descriptionEn: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.
entries.descriptionZh: 添加 /pua 来引导代理尝试另一种方法并在声明完成之前验证结果，具有 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局和每个对话设置，以及一个可选循环，该循环将持续到验证命令通过、达到迭代限制或用户取消。

entries.name: open-sea-skin
entries.title: Open Sea Skin
entries.descriptionEn: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin with quick controls for waves, daylight, glass opacity, and an automatic day cycle.
entries.descriptionZh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，可快速控制波浪、日光、玻璃不透明度和自动日循环。

entries.name: dsh-opencode-go
entries.title: Opencode Go
entries.descriptionEn: OpenCode Go provider with live gateway model discovery, online models.dev capability metadata, session routing, and Web settings with subscription usage.
entries.descriptionZh: OpenCode Go 提供商提供实时网关模型发现、在线 models.dev 功能元数据、会话路由和具有订阅使用的 Web 设置。

entries.name: dsh-onebot
entries.title: Onebot
entries.descriptionEn: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.
entries.descriptionZh: 通过 OneBot 11（NapCat 和朋友）进行 dsh 的 QQ 频道：反向或转发 WebSocket、DM 和群聊、图像和语音转录、t2i 文本图像卡、合并转发和设置页面。

entries.name: dsh-mobile-plugin
entries.title: Mobile Plugin
entries.descriptionEn: Endpoint of a companion mobile app that also runs headless, with no desktop shell or Electron required: it serves a restricted mobile API over a relay tunnel or LAN pairing, for listing, opening and driving DSH sessions, following the live device event stream, and authenticating with revocable per-device credentials.
entries.descriptionZh: 配套移动应用程序的端点也运行无头，不需要桌面 shell 或 Electron：它通过中继隧道或 LAN 配对提供受限的移动 API，用于列出、打开和驱动 DSH 会话，跟踪实时设备事件流，并使用可撤销的每设备凭据进行身份验证。

entries.title: Ide GIT
entries.descriptionEn: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.
entries.descriptionZh: 侧边栏的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工具窗口：带有前/后徽章的分支树、带有文本/作者/日期/路径过滤器的提交图、每个文件行差异、更改列表和提交框，以及分支、标记和存储操作、合并、变基、择优挑选、重置和获取/拉取/推送。

entries.name: dsh-console-plugin
entries.title: Console Plugin
entries.descriptionEn: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.
entries.descriptionZh: 通过二维码或六位代码将手机与该计算机的 DSH 实例配对，然后从面板远程驱动它 - 发送指令、查看图像、答复批准，并提供跨网络配对的公共隧道支持。

entries.name: dsh-find-plugins
entries.title: Find Plugins
entries.descriptionEn: Find DSH plugins across several community catalogs plus live GitHub and npm search, ranked by relevance, trust, freshness and bounded popularity instead of stars alone.
entries.descriptionZh: 在多个社区目录以及实时 GitHub 和 npm 搜索中查找 DSH 插件，按相关性、信任度、新鲜度和有限流行度排名，而不仅仅是明星。

entries.name: dsh-prompt-enhance
entries.title: Prompt Enhance
entries.descriptionEn: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
entries.descriptionZh: 编辑器中的一键提示增强功能 - 将草稿重写为结构化提示（角色和目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边缘情况），并具有前后预览、填充和撤消功能。从不改变意图，从不捏造要求。
